ecological_question: Does spatial turnover among small-mammal species create community-level spatial continuity that is absent from any single species?

primary_hypothesis.name: emergent_community_connectivity
primary_hypothesis.statement: Across fresh NEON sites, community-level world survival exceeds the best single-species survival because different local species assemblages occupy complementary positions in space.
primary_hypothesis.primary_null: whole observed local assemblages are permuted among the fixed guild-positive nodes, preserving the guild-positive node set, every species occupancy count, the multiset of node richness values, and within-node species co-occurrence vectors
primary_hypothesis.null_seed_rule: integer from first 8 hex digits of sha256('neon_metacommunity_connectivity_v1|'+site_code)
primary_hypothesis.aggregate_test: one-sided exact sign test of null-adjusted site effects > 0 against probability 0.5
confirmatory_support_if: one-sided exact sign-test p < 0.05 for positive null-adjusted site effects

mechanistic_secondary.strict_emergent_world_fraction: fraction of distinct worlds in which the guild survives but no eligible single species survives
mechanistic_secondary.cross_species_rescue_fraction: among guild-positive node x surviving-world targets, fraction having at least one guild-positive neighbour but no neighbour sharing any species with the target node
mechanistic_secondary.dominance_coverage: maximum across species of occupied guild-positive nodes divided by total guild-positive nodes
mechanistic_secondary.expected_pattern: emergent connectivity should increase with cross-species rescue and decrease with dominance coverage
mechanistic_secondary.association_test: Spearman rank correlation across scored sites, reported as secondary and not used to rescue the primary decision

literature_boundary.relation_to_spatial_insurance: Conceptually related to spatial insurance and compositional compensation, but the endpoint here is spatial occupancy/connectivity rather than ecosystem-function stability.

node_registry.discovery: recursive NEON site location hierarchy plus GraphQL findLocations
node_registry.x_coordinate_policy: trap coordinates containing X are prospectively excluded because the official NEON geolocation implementation treats them as uncertain locations

target_taxa.response_unit: ever-positive non-X trap by species across RELEASE-2026

site_response_estimability.unknown_non_x_positive_node_action: response-consumed site STOP with no registry repair
site_response_estimability.x_coordinate_positive_rows: excluded prospectively from spatial analysis and counted separately

survival_rules.community_positive_set: union of all eligible target-species positive nodes
survival_rules.species_positive_set: positive nodes for one eligible target species
survival_rules.one_step_compatibility: every positive target node has at least one positive peer node connected by an admitted canonical-world edge
survival_rules.community_survival_fraction: surviving canonical worlds / distinct canonical worlds
survival_rules.species_survival_fraction: same fraction calculated separately for each species with at least two positive nodes
survival_rules.max_species_survival_fraction: maximum over eligible species with at least two positive nodes

assemblage_permutation_null.permutation_unit: entire species-incidence row attached to a guild-positive node
assemblage_permutation_null.changes: spatial assignment of local assemblages to guild-positive node coordinates

failure_conditions: one-sided sign-test p >= 0.05 for positive null-adjusted site effects
community continuity is explainable by one widespread species at most sites
row-permutation null reproduces the observed emergent connectivity gains
forbidden: use any of the consumed 16 NEON sites as confirmatory evidence
retune world thresholds after fresh response access
change the target guild after fresh response access
repair unknown non-X positive nodes after response access
change permutation replicates or seed rule after response access
add sites until the sign test becomes significant
reinterpret the previous world-survival forecast failure as confirmatory evidence for this ecological hypothesis
